## Problem

Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
Example: _I'm always frustrated when [...]_

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. How should it work from a user or developer perspective?

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Who benefits from this (content editors, API consumers, plugin authors, DevOps)?

## Additional Context

Mockups, links to similar features in other CMS products, or technical notes are welcome.

## Would you contribute?

- [ ] I am willing to open a PR for this feature
- [ ] I need guidance from maintainers first
